title: ‘This is huge’ – Bitcoin completes first quantum-resistant transaction
summary: Bitcoin made a great step forward towards quantum-resistance.
content: Bitcoin has achieved a major milestone by successfully completing its first quantum-resistant transaction. This development marks a significant step forward for the digital currency as it prepares to defend against future advancements in quantum computing technology, which pose potential security threats to traditional cryptographic systems.

title: Swift accepts request to extend structured address migration for ISO 20022 messages
summary: Swift is extending the November deadline for moving from unstructured to structured postal addresses for ISO 20022 payment messages after a host of banks asked for more time to comply.
content: Swift has announced an extension to the November deadline for financial institutions transitioning from unstructured to structured postal addresses in ISO 20022 payment messages. The decision comes after numerous banks requested additional time to successfully implement the required compliance measures.

title: US Treasury targets growth, imbalances at G20 finance meeting as digital asset sanctions expand
summary:

content: At the recent G20 finance meeting, the US Treasury focused on economic growth and global imbalances while simultaneously expanding sanctions on digital assets. However, market participants warn that the broader enforcement measures could reshape international trade dynamics and create significant compliance challenges for digital asset platforms operating globally.

The post Anthropic Previews Standard for AI Control of Physical Devices appeared first on PYMNTS.com.
content: Anthropic has launched a research preview for the Model Hardware Standard, a shared specification allowing artificial intelligence agents to operate physical equipment.
